design.bands_definition: b = cycles per 32 samples; x(t) = A cos(2 pi b t / 32 + phi)
design.projection: probe.score (closed form) for integer b; sweep.retained (lstsq) for fractional b --- equal at integer b
design.seed_rule: cell rng seed = SEED + arm offset + cell index
design.interp_controls: truth at band 6 is exactly orthogonal to bands 4 and 8 over 32 samples, so explained_frac(truth6 | span{yhat4,yhat8}) ~ 0 and a random vector explains ~ 2/32

api.column_semantics: col 0 = mean, cols 1..9 = quantiles 0.1..0.9, col 5 = median; use_continuous_quantile_head replaces cols 1-4,6-9 with the separate output_projection_quantiles head and leaves col 5 (the point) unchanged
